subject: Executive one-pager: key outcomes, operational risks & procurement plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jill Spencer <jill.spencer@avelonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Executive one-pager: key outcomes, operational risks & procurement plan

Hi Jill —

Thanks again for taking time today with the exec team. Quick follow-up to lock in what we heard and the clear next steps so your procurement and security squads can move quickly. I attached a 1‑pager for your board (redwood-exec-onepager.pdf) and our SOC 2 summary.

Recap of the conversation (high level):
- Primary business outcome: reduce average support-handling time by ~35% and deflect routine reimbursements via automated summarization and QA.
- Top technical pain: high API latency on current vendor with no predictable SLA during batch inference spikes; insecure data egress controls needed for PHI workflows.
- Success metrics: 35% deflection, 25% latency reduction (p95 < 250ms), pilot ROI horizon: 90 days.
- Operational risks flagged by your team: data retention policy, KMS integration, and audit log granularity for clinical review.

Procurement path we discussed:
1) Pilot (30–60 days) with dedicated capacity and SOC2 evidence -> success metrics review with engineering and clinical ops.
2) Procurement engagement (legal + vendor security) for contract terms and data processing annex.
3) Board/exec signoff if pilot meets thresholds.

Asks / next steps (I can own coordination):
- I'll share the one-pager + SOC 2 summary (attached) with procurement and legal.
- Can you introduce procurement (procurement@avelonhealth.com) on this thread? If you prefer, I can send a tailored pilot statement of work to speed review.
- Proposed timeline: kickoff next week (Nov 8–10), document exchange week of Nov 15, pilot start Nov 22.

Attachments: redwood-exec-onepager.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short pilot scope draft and pricing bands targeted at dedicated capacity to match your throughput needs.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

---
From: Jill Spencer <jill.spencer@avelonhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive one-pager: key outcomes, operational risks & procurement plan

Naomi —

Appreciate the clear summary. This matches what the leadership team took away. A couple quick clarifications:
- The clinical team will need guaranteed data isolation (VPC/on-prem options) and the ability to redact PHI before any external processing.
- Our security lead asked for KMS integration details and sample audit logs before we proceed to legal.

I looped in procurement (procurement@avelonhealth.com) — they will confirm our standard contracting timeline. I also asked them to let us know if they need an SOW or PO template from you.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you provide an example audit-log export (redacted) and a short KMS integration note by EOD Friday?
2) Pricing: procurement requested an indicative pilot price and an example renewal/commit tier so they can model the numbers.

If you can get those items in the next 72 hours, procurement can likely get an initial review on the calendar next week.

Thanks,
Jill
VP, Product & Clinical Ops
Avelon Health
jill.spencer@avelonhealth.com

To: Jill Spencer <jill.spencer@avelonhealth.com>, Avelon Health Procurement <procurement@avelonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive one-pager: key outcomes, operational risks & procurement plan

Hi Jill & procurement team —

Thanks for the quick reply and for loop-in. Helpful notes — we can absolutely provide the items you requested. Attached is a short pilot scope draft and an indicative pricing band for a 30‑day dedicated-capacity pilot (pilot-scope-draft.docx).

What we are sending by EOD Friday:
- Redacted audit-log sample (showing token-level event types and timestamps)
- KMS integration note (supported providers, setup checklist, HSM options)
- Formal pilot SOW + indicative pilot cost and two renewal tiers (reserved capacity and committed usage).

Proposed next steps to keep timeline:
- Nov 5: Naomi to send audit-log sample + KMS note + SOW (by COB PT).
- Nov 9: Procurement and legal initial read and comment.
- Nov 15: Pilot kickoff if SOW approved; otherwise alignment call to resolve open security questions.

Open items I’ll monitor: SOC 2 evidence relevance for clinical data, specific retention windows you require, and whether you need an on‑prem deployment variant for the pilot.

If procurement prefers, we can do a short 30-minute tech drop with our security engineer this week to walk the KMS and audit examples. Let me know a time window that works.

Best,
Naomi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Jill Spencer <jill.spencer@avelonhealth.com>, Avelon Health Procurement <procurement@avelonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive one-pager: key outcomes, operational risks & procurement plan

Looping in a couple of quick internal notes on the ask and our playbook:
- Security engineer can run a 30-minute session Wed or Thu (Nov 4–5) to demo the audit-log export and KMS flow. We should offer both KMS hosted and HSM options.
- Pricing: I'll prepare a short tiered quote (pilot, 6-mo committed, 12-mo reserved) and flag a standard 15% pilot discount for first-time exec pilots. If Avelon asks for deeper discounting, I need an exec signoff.
- Contracting: add a data processing annex and explicit PHI handling clauses; legal typically takes 7–10 business days after SOW submission.

Marissa — can you draft the quote and SOW redlines? Sean — please prepare a 1-page security note that Naomi can attach. I’ll shepherd escalation to our sales director if Avelon pushes for a custom SLA.

Thanks — I’ll monitor procurement replies and update the deal in HubSpot.

Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
